pages.title: Vegeta in Saiyan Armor with Crossed Arms Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta stands with crossed arms in his original Saiyan armor in this printable coloring page, showing broad shoulder pads, segmented hip guards, and his tail around his waist. The upright hair and angular armor define his full-body silhouette. Small foreground rocks and distant ridges add background accents to this Dragon Ball Z coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Touching His Scouter Beside Nappa Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Vegeta checking Goku's power level with his scouter while Nappa stands beside him on Earth's rocky battlefield. Vegeta touches the device at his temple, and both wear broad Saiyan shoulder armor. Their contrasting heights, segmented armor plates, and the scattered stones give this coloring sheet distinctive shapes.

pages.title: Vegeta Climbing Into a Round Space Pod Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta climbs into his open Saiyan space pod to leave Earth after his first battle with Goku in this printable coloring page, lifting one boot toward the seat. His damaged clothing and scuffed armor contrast with the rounded spacecraft shell. The open circular hatch and distant rocky mesas add details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta and Nappa Beside an Emerging Saibaman Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Vegeta watching a Saibaman emerge from the ground while Nappa plants seeds on the rocky battlefield, kneeling with his hand lowered. Vegeta stands with crossed arms and a scouter as the small creature pushes through cracked earth. Armor panels, falling seeds, and angular stones add detail to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Facing Goku Across a Rocky Plain Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta faces Goku across a deserted rocky valley before their first duel in this printable coloring page, with Vegeta's armored back and long tail in the foreground. Goku stands opposite in his tied martial arts uniform. Tall mesas and scattered stones frame their contrasting silhouettes on this Dragon Ball Z coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta and Goku in Fighting Stances Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Vegeta bracing against Goku's raised-leg attack during their first Saiyan Saga battle, with one forearm held near his face. Goku balances on one boot with his other knee bent high, while rocky cliffs and scattered stones frame the coloring sheet. Vegeta's shoulder armor and ribbed boots add smaller sections.

pages.title: Goku and Vegeta Clashing with Energy Beams Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Vegeta firing his Galick Gun from the sky against Goku's upward Kamehameha, with the beams meeting in a jagged central burst. Goku braces on the rocky ground while Vegeta hovers above him. Straight energy rays and distant cliffs frame the opposing diagonal poses on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta Raising a Power Ball Above His Hand to Create an Artificial Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta raises a Power Ball above his hand to create an artificial moon in this printable coloring page, standing in Saiyan armor with his tail curved outward. Circular motion strokes surround the sphere above his open palm. Broad shoulder plates, segmented hip guards, and scattered ground rocks add varied shapes to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Great Ape Vegeta Roaring in Saiyan Armor Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Vegeta in Great Ape form roaring in expanded Saiyan armor above a rocky battlefield, with clenched fists and a wide, toothed mouth. Fur outlines surround the broad armor panels, and a long tail curls beside his body. Small mesas and scattered stones establish scale beneath the figure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta Dodging Dodoria's Punch Beside the Unusual Trees of Planet Namek Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta dodges Dodoria's punch beside the unusual trees of Planet Namek in this printable coloring page, leaning away from the large fist in the foreground. Dodoria's spiked head and broad armor contrast with Vegeta's smaller frame. Twisting trunks and mushroom-like tree crowns create detailed shapes behind the fighters on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Facing an Armored Zarbon on Rocky Ground Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Vegeta facing Zarbon in his transformed monster form on Namek, with the larger armored figure crouched slightly and holding clawed hands forward. Zarbon has long swept-back hair and spotted skin, while Vegeta keeps his fists clenched. Rounded trees, rocky cliffs, and grass add background details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta Recovering Inside a Medical Tank Aboard Frieza's Spaceship Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta recovers inside a medical tank aboard Frieza's spaceship in this printable coloring page, floating with closed eyes and wearing a mask attached to a ribbed hose. Bubbles surround his body within the tall cylindrical chamber. Curved glass, thick metal rims, and a small control unit provide contrasting sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Throwing Dragon Balls Through a Round Window Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Vegeta tossing stolen Namekian Dragon Balls through a window of Frieza's spaceship, holding one sphere while extending his other arm. Two star-marked balls fly outside above Namek's cliffs and trees. The large circular window, curved room panels, and segmented armor create varied coloring areas on this sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Holding a Four-Star Dragon Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta holds a large Namekian Dragon Ball beside rounded trees and island cliffs in this printable coloring page, gripping the four-star sphere with both hands. His upright hair and chest armor rise above the broad circle. A slender tree, distant plateau, and scattered stones add smaller sections around the central figure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta Joining Gohan and Krillin to Confront the Ginyu Force on Namek Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Vegeta joining Gohan and Krillin to confront the Ginyu Force on Namek, with the three heroes grouped before five armored opponents. Vegeta stands in the middle with clenched fists as the taller enemy lineup fills the distance. Repeating shoulder plates, distinct hairstyles, and rocky ground add detail to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta Leaping Forward with a Clenched Fist to Attack Recoome on Namek Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta leaps forward with a clenched fist to attack Recoome on Namek in this printable coloring page, extending one arm toward the larger fighter's chest armor. Recoome stands firmly with his fists lowered. Their contrasting sizes and poses stand out against a sparse landscape of rocks, distant mesas, and a round-topped tree on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Resting with Crossed Arms in a Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Vegeta sleeping with crossed arms against a cave wall while waiting for Krillin on Namek, seated with his knees bent. His closed eyes, segmented chest armor, and large boots fill the foreground. The cave's uneven edge reveals a slender tree and rocky ground outside on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta in Damaged Armor Facing Frieza Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Vegeta in damaged shoulderless battle armor facing Frieza in his final form on Namek, with both fighters standing on rocky ground. Vegeta's torn clothing and scuffed chest plate contrast with Frieza's smooth body and curved tail. Distant mesas and a single round tree add background accents to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta in His Badman Shirt Beside Bulma Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta wears his Badman shirt while standing beside Bulma outside Capsule Corporation in this printable coloring page, folding his arms beside her belted dress. The shirt lettering and large Capsule building emblem distinguish the scene. Buttons, boots, palm trees, and rows of windows provide smaller sections around the figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta and Trunks with a Sheathed Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Vegeta watching Future Trunks with his sword put away after defeating Frieza and King Cold, with the two opponents behind them. Trunks wears a Capsule jacket and a long sheath across his back, while Vegeta folds his arms. The clothing seams, chest armor, and rocky setting add detail to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Doing Push-Ups on a Tiled Training Room Floor Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta does push-ups inside Capsule Corporation's gravity training chamber in this printable coloring page, spreading his hands across a tiled floor beneath a round wall window. His bent elbows and straight body form a low diagonal pose. Large room panels contrast with the smaller fingers, hair spikes, and uniform folds on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta with a Jagged Aura Facing Android 19 Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Vegeta revealing his Super Saiyan transformation to Android 19 on the rocky battlefield, standing inside a jagged aura with clenched fists. Android 19 raises his hands beneath a pointed hat and rounded sleeves. Segmented chest armor, baggy pants, and scattered rocks create contrasting sections throughout this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta Unleashing a One-handed Big Bang Attack at Android 19 Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta unleashes a one-handed Big Bang Attack at Android 19 in this printable coloring page, extending an open palm toward a round sphere edged with sharp energy strokes. Android 19 leans back with both hands raised. Broad outfit shapes and the small stones across the battlefield provide varied spaces on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Super Saiyan Vegeta Blocking Android 18's Punch on a Mountain Road Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Super Saiyan Vegeta blocking Android 18's punch on a mountain road, raising his forearm as she stretches one arm forward. Her striped sleeves, short vest, and belt contrast with his chest armor. The curved guardrail and jagged mountains frame their full-body poses on this Dragon Ball Z coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta and Trunks Sparring Beside a Pavilion Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta trains with Future Trunks beside the entrance pavilion in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber in this printable coloring page, with both fighters wearing matching chest armor. They hold raised fists in front of the domed doorway and steps. Broad muscle shapes contrast with segmented armor panels and flowing hair on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Pointing at Himself Beside Cell Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Super Vegeta pointing his thumb toward himself while challenging Cell in his second form, standing beside the much taller spotted opponent. Cell's thick tail, rounded shoulder plates, and broad head crest create a contrasting silhouette. Rocky peaks and scattered stones surround the two full-body figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Firing an Energy Blast at Cell in the Sky Coloring Page
pages.description: Super Vegeta fires his Final Flash at Perfect Cell above the island battlefield in this printable coloring page, bracing on a rocky ledge as the beam reaches Cell. The attack's jagged outlines connect the foreground fighter with his airborne opponent. Water, flat-topped islands, and small rocks provide background details across this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Blocking a Cell Jr.'s Punch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Super Saiyan Vegeta defending himself against a Cell Jr. at the Cell Games, crossing his forearms against the smaller fighter's punch. Cell Jr.'s spotted limbs, pointed crest, and wing-like back plates add distinctive details. Cracked arena tiles and scattered rubble create additional sections beneath the figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta, Goku, Gohan, Trunks, and Piccolo at an Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta stands with Goku, Gohan, Piccolo, and Future Trunks beside the Cell Games arena in this printable coloring page, forming a five-character group before the tiled platform. Piccolo folds his arms beneath a turban and cape, while Vegeta stands at the front. Armor panels, spiky hair, and scattered stones add details throughout this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Saluting Trunks Beside a Capsule Vehicle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Vegeta giving Future Trunks a two-finger farewell salute beside the time machine, with its rounded canopy and landing supports behind them. Trunks carries a sword across his back and wears a cropped jacket. Armor panels, buckled boots, and small ground stones add details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta with Bulma and Trunks on a Bench Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta sits with Bulma and young Trunks at Capsule Corporation in this printable coloring page, wearing a casual T-shirt and loose trousers on a slatted bench. Trunks smiles between his parents with his feet hanging above the grass. The domed building, shrubs, and clothing folds add varied sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Blocking a Boy's Punch in a Training Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Vegeta sparring with young Super Saiyan Trunks inside the gravity training room, raising his forearm against the boy's outstretched punch. Trunks wears a tied martial arts uniform beside Vegeta's sleeveless bodysuit. The central machine column, round windows, and tiled floor create geometric background shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Watching Trunks and Goten Sparring Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta watches young Trunks face Goten in the junior final of the World Martial Arts Tournament in this printable coloring page, standing with folded arms beside the ring. Both boys raise their fists on the tiled platform. Vegeta's foreground silhouette contrasts with the small fighters, railing, and tournament gateway on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta and Goku Descending a Circular Shaft Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Vegeta descending into Babidi's hidden spaceship with Goku, Gohan, and the Supreme Kai, arranged beneath a broad circular opening. Goku wears a halo, and the Supreme Kai has pointed ears and dangling earrings. Their different outfits and bent legs provide clear character sections within the curved shaft on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta in His Sleeveless Bodysuit Fighting Pui Pui on Planet Zoon Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta fights Pui Pui on Planet Zoon in his sleeveless bodysuit in this printable coloring page, extending a punch toward the armored opponent's raised guard. Pui Pui has a tall pointed head and segmented torso panels. Rocky mesas and scattered stones frame the two wide stances on this Dragon Ball Z coloring sheet.

pages.title: Majin Vegeta Standing with Clenched Fists Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Majin Vegeta standing in the World Martial Arts Tournament ring with the M symbol on his forehead and both fists clenched. His tall hair and sleeveless bodysuit fill the center above the tiled floor. Palm trees, low walls, and small tournament rooftops add background detail to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta and Goku Clashing Fists on a Rocky Plain Coloring Page
pages.description: Majin Vegeta clashes fists with Super Saiyan 2 Goku in a rocky wasteland in this printable coloring page, with a small impact burst between their extended arms. The fighters stand with bent knees and their other fists drawn back. Upright hair, loose uniform folds, and cracked ground provide distinct shapes throughout this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Majin Vegeta Kneeling to Hug Trunks Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Majin Vegeta embracing young Trunks before his Final Explosion against Majin Buu, kneeling with both arms wrapped around the boy. Trunks rests against Vegeta's chest with his eyes closed. The Majin forehead symbol, tied sash, folded clothing, and scattered battlefield rocks add details around this close-up coloring sheet.

pages.title: Majin Vegeta Punching Majin Buu on Rocky Ground Coloring Page
pages.description: Majin Vegeta throws a punch at Majin Buu beside the wreckage of Babidi's spaceship in this printable coloring page, pressing his fist toward Buu's rounded stomach. Buu raises his arms beneath a flowing cape and curved head antenna. Damaged machinery, small stones, and broad clothing folds create varied sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Majin Vegeta Surrounded by a Jagged Energy Aura Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Majin Vegeta unleashing his Final Explosion with a vast burst of energy surrounding him, standing over cracked ground with clenched fists. Tall, jagged energy outlines extend beyond his spiky hair and boots. The open aura sections contrast with his muscular arms and smaller forehead symbol on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta with a Halo Beside Goku and Buu Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta returns with a halo above his head to stand beside Goku against Super Buu in this printable coloring page, with all three figures on rocky ground. Vegeta's sleeveless bodysuit contrasts with Goku's tied uniform and Buu's loose pants. The curved head antenna, halo, and distant ridges add distinctive shapes to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Goku Tossing an Earring Toward Haloed Vegeta Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Vegeta catching the Potara earring tossed to him by Goku before their fusion, with the small ornament suspended between their open hands. Vegeta wears a halo, while Goku smiles beside him. Broad clothing areas, a curved throw line, and distant rock towers add details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Goku and Vegeta Opening Pods Around Two Boys Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta and Goku rescue their sons from hanging cocoons inside Majin Buu's body in this printable coloring page, pulling apart the oval coverings around Trunks and Goten. Both boys look outward from the openings beside their fathers. Curving organic walls, repeated oval marks, and folded uniforms create varied sections across this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Blocking Kid Buu's Punch in a Grassy Field Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Super Saiyan 2 Vegeta holding off Kid Buu in the grassy Supreme Kai's realm, raising his forearm against Buu's outstretched punch. Small lightning outlines surround Vegeta's upright hair. Grass tufts, distant plateaus, and cratered spheres fill the landscape behind the two fighters on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Calling Out Beside Goku's Spirit Bomb Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta calls on Earth's people to give their energy to Goku's Spirit Bomb in the Supreme Kai's realm in this printable coloring page, holding one hand beside his mouth. Goku stands behind him with both arms raised beneath a huge sphere. The broad circle contrasts with grass tufts and torn uniform edges on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta Giving Goku a Thumbs-up After Kid Buu Is Defeated Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Vegeta giving Goku a thumbs-up after Kid Buu is defeated, with both fighters standing in damaged clothing on grassy ground. Goku smiles beside Vegeta's raised hand beneath several round celestial shapes. Ragged fabric edges, scattered grass, and distant cliffs add smaller details around the large figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta Fighting a Top-Hatted Android Coloring Page
pages.description: Super Saiyan Vegeta fights Android 15 on the icy battlefield from Super Android 13 in this printable coloring page, extending a punch toward the smaller opponent's raised arm. Android 15 wears round glasses, a bow tie, and a tall hat. Wide ground cracks and distant peaks add angular sections around the fighters on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta with a Halo Facing Sword-Wielding Janemba Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Vegeta in his sleeveless bodysuit confronting sword-wielding Janemba among the strange formations of the Other World, with a halo above Vegeta's hair. Janemba holds a long blade beneath tall curved horns, and his tail loops behind him. Rounded floating shapes and unusual columns add details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Goku and Vegeta Performing the Fusion Dance Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta and Goku perform the Fusion Dance with halos above their heads in this printable coloring page from Fusion Reborn, leaning inward with their fingertips touching. Vegeta wears his sleeveless bodysuit beside Goku's tied uniform. Lifted knees, curved arms, and small floating circles create clear shapes across this Dragon Ball Z coloring sheet.

pages.title: Vegeta and Bulma Wearing Jackets Outdoors Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Vegeta wearing his end-of-Z jacket beside Bulma at the World Martial Arts Tournament, standing with crossed arms as she smiles. Bulma wears a cropped jacket and belted trousers, with a tournament building behind them. Jacket zippers, cuffs, floor tiles, and palm trees supply smaller details on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta By Namekian Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta stands by a Namekian lake in this printable coloring page, crossing his arms in battle armor and wearing a scouter beneath several crescent moons. Rounded trees and rocky cliffs reflect in the still water behind him. The large armor panels and smaller reflection outlines create contrasting sections throughout this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta at Check-in Station Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Vegeta at a check-in station, standing behind a wide counter with a small monitor, keyboard, and identification card in front of him. His segmented chest armor and tall hair fill the center of the scene. Rectangular wall frames and the counter panels create simple geometric spaces on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta at Capsule Corporation Coloring Page
pages.description: Vegeta stands at Capsule Corporation in this printable coloring page, shown in a close view wearing chest armor marked with the company's circular emblem. Control consoles, small screens, and a rounded chamber appear behind him. His angular hair and broad armor panels contrast with the finer buttons and display outlines on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dragon Ball Z Vegeta in Cell Games Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Vegeta in the Cell Games arena, standing with clenched fists in front of broken rocks and cracked floor tiles. His upright hair and segmented chest armor fill the central portrait. Broad armor panels contrast with small rubble fragments and distant rocky peaks on this Dragon Ball Z coloring sheet.
